URL -> CODE LINE MAP
=====================
For each URL: urls.py line, views.py function+line, forms.py class+line (if any),
email trigger (which send_..._email() call fires and from where), and notification
file data (the notifications.py function + line that actually builds/sends the email).

##################################################
#         EMAILS NOT TIED TO ANY URL/VIEW        #
#      (fired by a scheduled `manage.py` command) #
##################################################

send_expiry_alert_admin_email
  command      -> python manage.py send_expiry_alerts
  command file -> apps/stock/management/commands/send_expiry_alerts.py (line 30 calls it)
  notify.py    -> send_expiry_alert_admin_email (line 7)   [file: apps/stock/notifications.py]
  what it does -> emails admin one digest of every expired/soon-to-expire stock batch

send_insurance_expiry_email
  command      -> python manage.py send_insurance_reminders
